hero.title: Automobile Engineering (UG) in Mauritius
hero.subtitle: Bachelor’s in Automobile Engineering is designed for students with an interest in vehicle design, automotive systems, engines, manufacturing, electric vehicles and transport technology. The subject is a combination of mechanical engineering and automotive applications. **Automobile Engineering in Mauritius for Indian Students** is an option worth exploring for students interested in vehicle technology and engineering education.

overview: Important Note on Course Availability: The list of undergraduate programs published by the University of Mauritius for 2026-2027 does not include a dedicated Bachelor’s in Automobile Engineering. It does have a 4 year BEng (Hons) Mechanical Engineering and a 4 year BEng (Hons) Mechatronics Engineering which may provide related engineering foundations. These qualifications are alternatives and not similar to Automobile Engineering. Students planning to **Study Automobile Engineering in Mauritius** should understand the difference between a dedicated automobile engineering degree and related engineering courses.

faq.question: Are there Bachelors in Automobile Engineering Mauritius?
faq.answer: The University of Mauritius’s published list of undergraduate programs for 2026–2027 did not feature a dedicated bachelor’s degree in Automobile Engineering. Related choices are Mechanical Engineering and Mechatronics Engineering. Students looking for Automobile Engineering in Mauritius for Indian Students should verify the current course list before applying.

faq.question: Are there any universities in Mauritius offering related engineering courses?
faq.answer: The University of Mauritius offers four year BEng (Hons) degrees in Mechanical Engineering and Mechatronics Engineering. Please contact the university to verify the present curriculum and availability of automotive-related electives or projects. Students exploring Automobile Engineering Universities in Mauritius should confirm the latest programme details directly with the institution.

faq.question: What is the cost to study Automobile Engineering in Mauritius?
faq.answer: No confirmed tuition fee for a dedicated Automobile Engineering degree is available as the program has not been confirmed. Estimated living costs for initial planning are MUR 20,500–39,000 per month, or about ₹38,950–₹74,100 based on the illustrative exchange rate above. Plus other expenses such as tuition. For accurate Automobile Engineering Fees in Mauritius, contact the university for the applicable international tuition fee.

faq.question: What are the important subjects in engineering courses?
faq.answer: Mathematics is particularly important and Physics or other science subjects may be needed depending on the program. Students should check the university and qualification they have chosen for the exact eligibility requirements.

faq.question: Can I work in the automobile industry after studying Mechanical Engineering in Mauritius?
faq.answer: A degree in Mechanical Engineering can provide a foundation for work in the automotive field. However, employment will depend on the position, curriculum, practical skills and the requirements of the employer. Internships, relevant projects and further automotive training can all help strengthen your profile.
